name: Hussein Dey
contribution: The last Dey of the Regency of Algiers who ruled from 1818 until the invasion of Algiers in 1830.

checks.lead: Hussein Dey also known as Hussein II (real name Hüseyin bin Hüseyin; 1765–1838; Arabic: حسين داي) was the last Dey of the Regency of Algiers who ruled from 1818 until the invasion of Algiers in 1830.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
